steps.title: How this test works
steps.body: The TCF Canada speaking test has three tasks: a short talk about yourself, a role-play and an opinion. Here you practise useful sentences out loud and choosing the right reply. At B2 you defend a position, agree with nuance and disagree politely.

steps.fr: Je suis tout à fait d'accord, cependant il faut tenir compte des inconvénients.
steps.en: I completely agree; however, we must consider the drawbacks.
steps.tip: Agree first, then add the nuance.

steps.fr: Il me semble que cette solution présente plus d'avantages que d'inconvénients.
steps.en: It seems to me that this solution has more advantages than drawbacks.
steps.tip: Il me semble que softens a strong opinion.

steps.fr: Je comprends votre point de vue, mais je ne partage pas votre avis.
steps.en: I understand your point of view, but I do not share your opinion.

options: Je comprends votre point de vue, mais je ne suis pas d'accord.

steps.prompt: Which order builds the strongest spoken argument?
options: Opinion, two reasons, an example, conclusion
steps.explain: A clear structure is what the examiner listens for.
